description: In anesthetized monkeys, V1 still responds to and detects line segments, but the figure-ground modulation is absent (Lamme et al. 1998, as reported by Lamme).
limitations: Reported secondhand in Lamme 2020. The original study, from Lamme's group, is not read here.

sources.quote: When anesthetized, feedforward activation and detection of line segments is still present, yet the figure-ground modulation is selectively absent
